svg.text: Exon and domain architecture per species · MSA-aligned coordinates
For each species, where do the coding exon boundaries of the primary protein fall relative to the edges of its annotated domains?
MSA column of the cross-species primary-protein alignment

Both tracks of a species share one alignment axis, so a vertical connector reads directly as the distance between an exon boundary and a domain edge. An aligned column means residues were aligned, not that they are equivalent.
